observations: Photo 0 shows a rechargeable standing fan with a wall/charging cable visible; fan head and blades are intact.
Photo 1 shows a close view of the fan grille and center hub; the charging unit/handle-like battery pack is attached on the right side.
No visible brand/model label is readable on the fan hub or battery pack in either photo.
No photo shows the battery capacity indicator, charging port details, or a running-time test.

claims.claim: Used Qasa rechargeable fan for sale.
claims.evidence: Brand 'Qasa' is not readable on the fan/battery in photo 0 or photo 1.

claims.claim: Lasts up to 2 hours when fully charged and longer when on low.
claims.evidence: No photo/video of a full-charge runtime test at high/low speeds.

risks.risk: Battery runtime may be much shorter than claimed due to battery wear (common with rechargeable fans).
risks.proof: A short video showing the fan running on high immediately after a full charge, with a timer overlay (or phone stopwatch) for at least 30–60 minutes, plus a second clip on low.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not meeting the claimed runtime (worst case: treat as low/unknown runtime).

risks.risk: Charging may be faulty (battery not charging fully, loose charging connection, or degraded charger).
risks.proof: A clip showing charging from empty to full (indicator/light changes) and then starting the fan.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as charging reliability unknown (worst case: assume it may not charge properly).

risks.risk: Fan performance issues (weak airflow, wobbling blades, motor noise) not visible in still photos.
risks.proof: A video of the fan running on high and low, showing blade balance and steady airflow, plus any unusual sounds.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as performance unknown (worst case: assume reduced airflow).

risks.risk: Missing accessories/parts (charger cable, battery pack condition, remote/controls if any).
risks.proof: A photo laid out showing all included items: charger/cable, battery pack, and any manuals/parts.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as incomplete/unknown inclusions (worst case: assume charger/cable may be missing or not original).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of any brand/model label on the fan hub and on the battery/charging unit (so we can confirm 'Qasa' and the exact model).
Send a video: charge indicator from full/ready, then run on high with a visible timer for at least 30–60 minutes.
Send a second video: run on low with a visible timer to confirm 'longer on low'.
Send a photo showing the charger/cable and any included accessories laid out.
response.reason: The photos confirm it’s a rechargeable standing fan, but the key pricing drivers (battery runtime, charging health, and exact brand/model) are not verifiable from the images. To avoid overpaying, we need runtime and charging proof.
